test_title: PYST 39: SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On: 27 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

I have thus far sketched the events of my life, but I have not shown how much I have depended on books not only for pleasure and for the **__wisdom__** they bring to all who read, but also for that knowledge which comes to others through their eyes and their ears.
solution:
The correct answer is "insight."**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 

 

__
 
• The word "wisdom" means the ability to make sensible decisions and judgements because of your knowledge or experience. ((ज्ञान या अनुभव के आधार पर) विवेकपूर्ण निर्णय लेने की क्षमता, समझदारी, बुद्धिमानी, अक़लमंदी)

 
 
• Example:* I don’t see the **wisdom**__ of this plan*.
 
 
 
• The synonym of "wisdom" is "insight."
 
• The word "insight" means a clear, deep, and sometimes sudden understanding of a complicated problem or situation. (किसी जटिल समस्या या स्थिति की स्पष्ट, गहरी और कभी-कभी अचानक समझ)
 __
 
• Example: *It was an interesting book, full of fascinating **insights**__ into human relationships.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 3.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ 

 

 
• Clarity: **the quality of being clear and easy to understand. (स्‍पष्‍टता और सुबोधता)
 
• **Folly: **an act that is not sensible and may have a bad result. (विवेकहीन कार्य या क्रिया जिसका दुष्‍परिणाम हो सकता है; मूर्खता का काम; नासमझी)
 
• **Emotion: **a strong feeling such as love, anger, fear, etc. ((प्रेम, क्रोध, भय आदि) मनोभाव, भावना, भावावेश)
